source_reference.key_evidence: neuromaps provides standardized brain-map comparison tools and receptor PET annotations.
source_reference.use_in_project: Replace hand-built receptor proxies with documented receptor-map projections.
source_reference.claim_boundary: Current coarse receptor weights are proxy-only; receptor claims need PET-derived maps and spatial-autocorrelation-preserving nulls.

claim_guardrail: Receptor-specific claims require PET-derived 5-HT2A/FS5ht priors and spatial nulls.

network_control_energy.method: finite-horizon discrete network-control energy over matched PCA-state centroids; control profiles share the same mean control budget
network_control_energy.equation: x[t+1] = A_graph x[t] + B_profile u[t]; energy = min sum_t ||u[t]||^2 over a finite horizon
network_control_energy.graph_source: configs/graphs/macro_modules.yaml macro-module proxy graph; not a subject structural connectome
network_control_energy.receptor_prior_source: PET-derived prior from Hansen et al. Schaefer-100 PET 5-HT2A maps; z-scored and sample-size weighted
